title: POST /v1/setup/estimate: the optional `split` block (since engine API 1.2)
description: One model as two stage processes (front [0, cut), tail [cut, layers)), cut by cut, from the pack's headers on the box that answers. The block appears only when the request has a `split` ask ($defs.ask); a body without it is answered as before. Two shapes: splittable false (reason, message; legal_cuts with reason cuts), never an HTTP error; splittable true (every other field). Every number is COMPUTED (computed: true) except the `measured` list, which is what a split of this family was measured to cost on a GPU (informational). `fits` and `best_cut` assume two boxes of the answering box's preset: a planner with two different boxes compares each side's gb with each node's own budget_gb. Further fields may appear: additionalProperties is true.

reason.description: null when splittable; family: the engine is not served as two stages; pack: the profile's weights are not on this box or their headers do not read (ask a node that has the pack); cuts: none of the asked cuts is legal; caches: caches asked of a family that keeps no state split; slots: more slots than the family serves split

message.description: one sentence for a person; null when splittable

legal_cuts.description: every boundary 1..layers-1; on a not-splittable block only with reason cuts

shape.description: what was computed (without caches: one slot whatever the selection says)

kv_pool.description: always false: a stage keeps its rows in place

budget_gb.description: this device preset's total less the selection's floor

shared_gb.description: computed (pack headers): what both stages read beside their layers (embedding, head, final mixer)

tail_only_gb.description: computed (pack headers): what only the tail reads (draft layer, final norm)

kv_bytes_per_token_layer.description: computed (config): 0 for a layer without attention

section_bytes_layer.description: computed (config): recurrent and conv state a slot

table.description: computed (pack headers): the n-gram table; null without one

best_cut.description: the cut whose smaller headroom is largest among those where both sides fit two boxes of this preset; null when none fits (the last note says which side lacks how much)

computed.description: every number in the block but `measured` is computed

measured.description: MEASURED on a GPU, informational; empty when nothing was

ask.description: The optional `split` ask of POST /v1/setup/estimate, beside `selection` or inside a bare selection. true = all defaults; absent (or null beside a selection) = the estimate's body exactly as before. An invalid ask is 422 invalid_split with error.errors[].field split.<field>.

cuts.description: 1..4096 cuts to compute; default every legal cut; cuts that are not legal are left out and named in notes

caches.description: both stages keep state (TANDEM_STAGE_CACHES); default off = one slot

side_window.description: a side slot's window, 1..selection.window (QSE_SIDE_MAX_LEN); default the window

table.description: the n-gram table's policy; default the profile's

snapshots_gb.description: >= 0; the front's kept-state memory a slot (TANDEM_STAGE_SNAPSHOTS_GB); default the family's (2)

tail_disk_gb.description: >= 0; the tail's disk tier budget (informational); default 0

request.description: a request body with the ask beside the selection

cut.description: the front holds [0, cut), the tail [cut, layers)

carry_bytes_per_row.description: computed: bytes crossing the link per row of a block

table_on.description: the stage holding the n-gram table's reader; null without a table

fits.description: both sides fit this preset's budget

slot_gb.description: computed: one side slot on this stage (KV at the side window, sections, on the tail the draft cache); NOT its graphs and row buffers, which are not known a stage

table.description: this side holds the n-gram table's reader

pack_gb.description: the whole pack: both stages open its index and table

cache_dir_gb.description: the front: its cache folder (the ask's, caches on)

disk_tier_gb.description: the tail: its disk tier (the ask's, caches on)

id.description: weights, table, kv, sections, draft_kv (the tail), snapshots (the front, caches on), engine, allocator, and the registry's per-window parts (Flash-Next: prefill_workspace, window_buffers)

basis.description: where the figure comes from: the pack's file headers, the model's config, the ask, the model's registry entry, an engine setting the family names (the cold table's row cache), or the WHOLE model's registry figure in one process put on each stage (an upper bound: a stage's own was never measured)

gib.description: MEASURED memory, null when not measured

seconds.description: MEASURED time, one figure or several runs
